## Entity summary
David Dai is a Chinese-speaking real estate professional focused on rental listings, tenant placement, home buying, home selling, and property management consultation in Southern California. The website serves Chinese-speaking landlords, tenants, buyers, and sellers, while also supporting English-speaking clients.

## Core services
- Rental listing support for landlords
- Tenant placement and rental search support
- Home buying representation
- Home selling representation
- Property management consultation and referral
- Rental estimate requests through the website

## English guides
Each page answers one California landlord-tenant question in English, with official sources (Civil Code, California Attorney General, California Courts, Civil Rights Department) cited on the page. General information, not legal or tax advice.
- What is AB 1482? California Tenant Protection Act: rent cap, just cause and exemptions: https://rentalinca.com/en/ab-1482-california-tenant-protection-act.html
- California rent increase limit 2026: state cap, 30/90-day notice and local rent control: https://rentalinca.com/en/california-rent-increase-limit.html
- AB 1482 exemption notice: the exact statutory wording for single-family homes and condos: https://rentalinca.com/en/ab-1482-exemption-notice.html
- California security deposit limit (AB 12): one month, small-landlord exception, 21-day return: https://rentalinca.com/en/california-security-deposit-limit.html
- California pet deposit rules: security deposit cap, pet rent and assistance animals: https://rentalinca.com/en/california-pet-deposit.html
- California eviction process in Orange County: notice, unlawful detainer, sheriff: https://rentalinca.com/en/california-eviction-process-orange-county.html
